Item.Description: Documentary Control (A risk has been identified that requires the declarant to submit documentation for checking. The goods are required to be held.). CHIEF Equivalent: 1

Physical / External Party Control (A risk has been identified which requires the goods to be physically inspected by Border Force or some other third party. The goods are required to be held.). CHIEF Equivalent: 2
Non-Blocking Documentary Control (A documentary check has been requested, but the goods do not need to be held.). CHIEF Equivalent: 3
No control required (The declaration has been risked and no control has been required.). CHIEF Equivalent: 6
Risking not yet performed (The declaration is in a processing state which means that risking has not been performed yet.). CHIEF Equivalent: N/A
Probable: Documentary Control (A risk has been identified that requires the declarant to submit documentation for checking. The goods are required to be held.). CHIEF Equivalent: H1

Probable: Physical / External Party Control (A risk has been identified which requires the goods to be physically inspected by Border Force or some other third party. The goods are required to be held.). CHIEF Equivalent: H2
Probable: Non-Blocking Documentary Control (A documentary check has been requested, but the goods do not need to be held.). CHIEF Equivalent: H3
Probable: No control required (The declaration has been risked and no control has been required.). CHIEF Equivalent: H6
Probable: Risking not yet performed (The declaration is in a processing state which means that risking has not been performed yet.). CHIEF Equivalent: N/A
Pre-Lodge Prefix (The declaration is an advance/pre-lodged type, and as such the routing is provisional only.). CHIEF Equivalent: H
